scope: Modern receive-only RetroPilot car port, all canonical offline command encoders and no-diagnostic explicit selection

checks.command: .venv/bin/python -m unittest opendbc.car.tests.test_car_interfaces opendbc.car.tests.test_platform_configs opendbc.car.tests.test_can_fingerprint opendbc.car.tests.test_fw_fingerprint opendbc.car.tests.test_docs opendbc.car.tests.test_vehicle_model

limits: No hardware/managed stack/game/model/firmware/CAN TX or actuation test.
Receive-only/noOutput; Chimera backend, real safety, profile/calibration and complete BeamNG telemetry/motion remain pending.
Speed scale intentionally unqualified by default; legacy and saved Hall producer differ by100.
Only stated unit/interface suites run; no dataset/route/full-manager qualification.

review.correctness: No forced CAN validity, global ECU state, guessed gear/wheels/torque, or diagnostic TX. Exact-DLC checks preserve the base parser validity/timeout policy. Speed is invalid until explicitly qualified. Driver override/brake/cancel/ignition/stale input clear the local armed indicator.
review.readability: Separate platform, interface/state, passive controller, checksum and explicit command encoders; current support level and placeholders documented.
review.architecture: Modern opendbc platform; canonical DBC bytes unchanged. Real Chimera backend/board health and BeamNG sensor providers remain separate.
review.security: No device opens or active requests from the port. Active/NaN/infinite control requests return zero actuators/no CAN output. Offline encoders reject nonfinite/overflow requests and nonboolean enable.
review.performance: No runtime benchmark claimed. No camera/model/backend changes. Parser checks retain 20 Hz reference assumptions, not source-age or live rate proof.
